name: J'adore Eau de Toilette 2002
description: J'adore Eau de Toilette 2002 by Dior is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. J'adore Eau de Toilette 2002 was launched in 2002. Top notes are Plum, Neroli, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Lemon and Nutmeg; middle notes are Jasmine, Lily-of-the-Valley, Violet, Orchid, Rose and Magnolia; base notes are Plum, Musk and Vanilla. This is another way to taste J’adore’s splendour. The fragrance stayed the same, but in a milder concentration, as an edt. It is a floral fragrance with the freshness of mandarin in the top notes: jasmine, plum, orchid and rose in the heart; with amaranth, musk and blackberry in the trail. It was introduced in 2002.

name: Chanel N°19
description:
Chanel N°19 by Chanel is a Floral Green fragrance for women. Chanel N°19 was launched in 1970. The nose behind this fragrance is Henri Robert. Top notes are Galbanum, Hiacynth, Bergamot and Neroli; middle notes are Iris, Orris Root, Rose, Lily-of-the-Valley, Narcissus, Jasmine and Ylang-Ylang; base notes are Oakmoss, Vetiver, Leather, Cedar, Musk and Sandalwood. Number 19 in the name refers to the birth date of Coco Chanel, August 19. The perfume was launched in 1970 when Coco Chanel was 87 years old, a year before she died. It was created by Henri Robert, a perfume creator which created many other perfumes of the Chanel house.


The composition merges aggressive green note of galbanum and woody dusky note of iris as a harmonious bridge between delicate floral heart and leathery-woody base. Chanel N°19 is hard to classify and describe. It includes fragrant notes of galbanum, neroli, bergamot, jasmine, rose, lily of the valley, iris, vetiver, sandalwood, leather and musk.

pros.text: Aloof beauty that remains unrivaled in the world of perfumery
Sophisticated feminine take on the outdoors
Reacts uniquely to individual skin chemistry
Masterful balance of iris and galbanum

cons.text: Traditional French style feels dated to some
Intense galbanum note is highly polarizing
Cold, aloof vibe can feel uninviting
Astringent, piercingly sharp green opening
Acquired taste that may feel uninviting
Current formulations lack vintage depth and richness

name: Cinéma
description:
Cinéma by Yves Saint Laurent is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Cinéma was launched in 2004. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. Top notes are Almond Blossom, Clementine and Cyclamen; middle notes are Jasmine, Peony and Amaryllis; base notes are Vanilla, Amber, Benzoin and White Musk. Cinema can make every woman feel like a star. It is a fragrance for glamorous women who live under the spotlights, self-confident and elegant, women who know how to draw the attention. A seductive flavor reminds of Hollywood beauties from the romantic love movies, glamourous evening gowns, Hollywood hairstyles, high heels, black seamed stockings…



The top note is delicate and softly fresh (clementine, almond blossom and cyclamen). The heart reveals jasmine, peony and amaryllis. The drydown is warm, opulent, and balsamic with amber, musk and sweet powdery vanilla. The fragrance was created by Jacques Cavallier.



See the YSL Cinema video ad.

pros.text: Beautiful amber vanilla with nuances of clementine
Excellent longevity with a radiant trail
Sophisticated alternative to modern sugary gourmands
Unique blend of marzipan and candied orange

cons.text: Discontinued and increasingly difficult to find
Reformulated versions may lack original depth
Can have a brief synthetic sharpness in opening
Strong powdery notes may feel dated to some

name: Elle
description: Elle by Xerjoff is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Elle was launched in 2007. Top notes are African Orange Flower, Citruses and Galbanum; middle notes are Iris, Birch, Woodsy Notes and Patchouli; base notes are Benzoin, Opoponax, Amber and Musk.

pros.text: Versatile for office and special occasions
Sparkling fruity opening with resinous depth
Exceptional longevity on skin and clothing

cons.text: Requires high spray count for impact
Prohibitively expensive and poor value
Note pyramid is misleading and inaccurate
Feels too linear and lacks complexity
Unoriginal scent profile for the price
Performance varies wildly between different users
Weak projection often becoming skin scent
Overly sweet, candy-like lollipop opening
Drydown can feel heavy or dated
Strikingly similar to cheaper Lolita Lempicka

name: Ambition
description:
Ambition by Rasasi is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Top notes are Sage, Orange and Bergamot; middle notes are Floral Notes, Spices and Woodsy Notes; base notes are Musk and Amber. This is a perfume for ambitious men, no mater what generation they belong to. It opens with citrus notes of bergamot, orange peel and sage leaf. The heart features floral and woody notes blended with aromatic spices, laid on a base of musk and amber. 

 it is available as 70 ml EDP.

name: Shagya
description: Shagya by Parfums de Marly is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. Shagya was launched in 2009. The nose behind this fragrance is Sidonie Lancesseur. Top notes are Lime, Bergamot and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Agarwood (Oud), Virginia Cedar and Geranium; base notes are Vetiver, Guaiac Wood, Papyrus and Musk. Shagy is the scent of oriental oud and lime named by the Arab horses. Top notes: lime, bergamot and pink pepper. Heart: geranium, cedar and oud. Base: vetiver, guaiac wood, papyrus, and musk. Available as 125 ml EDT.

name: Maraseel Al Hub
description: Maraseel Al Hub by Arabiyat Prestige is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Top notes are Red Berries, Orange and Fruity Notes; middle notes are Lily, Gardenia and Violet; base note is Musk.

name: Sheikh Al Shuyukh
description: Sheikh Al Shuyukh by Lattafa Perfumes is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Agarwood (Oud) and Cedar; middle notes are Sage, Lavender and Rosemary; base notes are Vetiver and Patchouli.

name: Arabian Gems
description: Arabian Gems by Afnan is a fragrance for women. Top note is Pink Pepper; middle note is Orange Blossom; base notes are Tonka Bean, Vanilla and Benzoin.

name: Thailand Oud in Cairo
description: Thailand Oud in Cairo by PARIS CORNER is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. Thailand Oud in Cairo was launched in 2021. Top notes are Leather, Cardamom and Cinnamon; middle notes are Myrrh, Incense, Tobacco and Atlas Cedar; base notes are Thailand Oud, Cambodian Oud, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha and Patchouli.

name: Jack Of Clubs
description: Jack Of Clubs by Fragrance World is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Jack Of Clubs was launched in 2022. Top notes are Cardamom, Ginger and Bergamot; middle notes are Lavender and Geranium; base notes are Cedar and Vetiver.

pros.text: Affordable alternative to discontinued Bleu Electrique
Smooth, creamy, and pleasant dry down
Versatile for dates and casual wear
Excellent value at budget price point
Close resemblance to original La Nuit DNA
Unique presentation includes custom deck of cards

cons.text: Dominant powdery and makeup-like vibes
Harsh, synthetic, and chemical opening
Requires weeks of sitting to develop
Poor longevity and projection for many
Inferior to rival clones like Al Nashama Caprice
Scent feels dated or overly mature
Associations with baby wipes and detergent
Lacks complexity of the designer original
Inconsistent performance between different batches
Occasional reports of faulty atomizers

name: Affair
description: Affair by Mykonos is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. Top notes are Raspberry, Sorbet and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Peony and Rose; base notes are Vanilla, Cashmere Wood, Salted Caramel and Patchouli. Affair by Mykonos is an extrait de parfum that centers on a sweet, fruity and gourmand composition with a pronounced feminine character. The fragrance opens with an icy and tangy raspberry sorbet accord brightened by pink pepper, leading into a floral heart of rose and peony. In the base, patchouli, vanilla, cashmere wood and salted caramel create a warmer, more textured drydown, balancing earthy nuances with creamy, edible sweetness. The scent is presented as an exploration of self-love and playful sensuality, focusing on a modern, flirty floral-fruity profile with gourmand undertones.

name: Icarus
description: Icarus by Velixir is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Icarus was launched in 2024. Top notes are Pear, Calabrian bergamot and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Mandarin Orange, Orange Blossom, Georgywood and Ginger; base notes are Musk, Ambrofix™, Akigalawood and Cedarwood. Icarus by Velixir is a contemporary woody scent built around bright fruits, spices, and modern woody-amber notes. Pear, Calabrian bergamot, and mandarin orange open the fragrance with a fresh and slightly juicy impression, leading into a heart of ginger, orange blossom, Georgywood, and additional mandarin facets. The base is dominated by musk, Ambrofix, Akigalawood, and cedarwood, creating a smooth, woody-amber drydown with a clean, modern character.
